name: How can I find reliable contractors for pre-listing repairs?

mainEntity.name: How can I find reliable contractors for pre-listing repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finding reliable contractors for pre-listing repairs involves several steps: ask for referrals from your real estate agent or trusted friends, check online reviews and ratings, and always obtain multiple bids for any significant project. Verify licenses and insurance, and ensure a clear contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution often provides clients with a list of reputable local contractors and service providers who are familiar with the standards and expectations in areas like Key Biscayne or Pinecrest, streamlining the repair process for sellers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Find reliable contractors by asking for referrals, checking reviews, getting multiple bids, and verifying licenses. Your real estate agent can often provide trusted local contacts.
